methods.label: Use the defining properties of homothety
methods.explanation: Homothety is a special type of similarity: the lines joining corresponding points intersect at a single point (the center of homothety), and corresponding sides are parallel. Therefore, homothetic figures are always similar, but the converse is not necessarily true.
methods.levelReason: The explanation applies the defining Grade 9 relationship between homothety and similarity.
